---
title: "PSOE"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = FALSE, fig.path = "figures/")

# Idioma para los meses
locales <- c("es_ES.UTF-8", "Spanish_Spain.1252", "es_ES")
for (loc in locales) {
  res <- try(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", loc), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(res, "try-error") && !is.na(res)) break
}

# Cargar entorno y funciones
source("code/00_setup.R")
source("code/01_theme.R")
source("code/02_datos.R")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
variacion_idv <- df %>%
  filter(mes >= as.Date("2023-09-01")) %>%
  group_by(mes, idv_group) %>%
  tally(wt = ponde_mes_ajustada) %>%
  mutate(perc = round((n/sum(n)*100),1)) %>%
  filter(idv_group %in% c("PSOE")) %>%
  group_by(idv_group) %>% 
  mutate(idv_ini = perc[mes == min(mes)],
         variacion = perc - idv_ini)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
p_vrcn_idv_psoe <- ggplot(variacion_idv, aes(
  x = mes, y = variacion, color = idv_group, group = idv_group
)) +
  
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymax = 0, ymin = variacion), alpha = 0.1, colour = NA, fill = "#E3001B") +

  geom_line_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = NA_character_),  # <- clave para anularlo
    linewidth = .8
  ) +
  
  # PUNTOS INVISIBLES: capturan el hover por mes (tooltip correcto) pero no se ven
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = variacion_idv,
    aes(
      x = mes, y = variacion, color = idv_group,
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>", idv_group, "</b><br>",
        format(mes, "%B %Y", locale = "es_ES.UTF-8"), ": ",
        variacion, "%"
      )
    ),
    size = 9, alpha = 0, stroke = 0, show.legend = FALSE, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # ÚLTIMO PUNTO VISIBLE (con tooltip)
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = ultimo_por_grupo(variacion_idv, idv_group, mes),
    aes(
      x = mes, y = variacion, color = idv_group,
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>", idv_group, "</b><br>",
        format(mes, "%B %Y", locale = "es_ES.UTF-8"), ": ",
        variacion, "%"
      )
    ),
    size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = .2) +
  scale_x_date(labels = label_date("%b %y", locale = "es_ES")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colores_partidos) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    subtitle = "Variación IDV PSOE"
  ) +
  theme_1

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  girafe(
    ggobj = p_vrcn_idv_psoe,
    options = list(
      opts_hover(css = "stroke-width:3px;opacity:0.9;"),
      opts_tooltip(css = "background:white;color:black;padding:6px;
                           border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0px 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
                           font-family:Roboto;font-size:13px;"),
      opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE)
    )
  )
} else {
  dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
  static_plot_path <- file.path("figures", "p_vrcn_idv_psoe_static.png")
  ggsave(static_plot_path, plot = p_vrcn_idv_psoe, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  Sys.sleep(1)
  knitr::include_graphics(static_plot_path)
}
```

variacion_idv_genero <- df %>%

         variacion = perc - idv_ini)
